title: Disclaimers
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
body:
Assampedia is a general-information encyclopedia about Assam. Its articles are introductions for readers and students, not official, legal, medical or exam advice.

Accuracy

Articles are written from general public knowledge and may contain errors or become out of date. For official figures, dates, rules or decisions, check the Government of Assam, the Archaeological Survey of India, or the relevant official source.

No affiliation

Assampedia is an unofficial site in the style of Wikipedia. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Wikipedia or the Wikimedia Foundation, and its use of a similar layout does not imply any such connection.
